basic_info.description: Welcome to Unit 411 at Knox, a thoughtfully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence overlooking the building's beautifully landscaped interior courtyard. With views of the lush butterfly garden and a smart, efficient layout, this home offers a stylish and comfortable retreat in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and design-forward neighborhoods.    The kitchen features high-end appliances and a striking white quartz island, ideal for casual dining and entertaining. Large east-facing windows bring in natural light throughout the day and frame green courtyard views. Modern window coverings, Nest-controlled air conditioning, a walk-in closet, in-unit washer and dryer, and a secure garage parking space add ease and functionality.    Built in 2017, Knox is a sought-after building located where Dogpatch meets Potrero, just steps from the 22nd Street Caltrain Station, Muni T-Third, and major bus routes (22, 48). The building's amenities include a fully equipped fitness center, media room, ButterflyMX intercom system, package room, bike storage, an attended lobby, and a landscaped courtyard with fire pits and a BBQ area, perfect for relaxing or connecting with neighbors.
